title: Review booking finance and invoice draft
description: After a simulated confirmation, update customer income and supplier outflow projections and prepare a draft invoice, gated by human review.
guidance: Use only a recorded simulated confirmation. The operator must approve the exact category and amount in Activity. Add the customer quote to Simulated pipeline and supplier cost to Simulated commitment, never Actual; add a Booking log row and create an invoice marked DRAFT - NOT ISSUED. No real invoice or payment is sent.
